questions.question: for(i=1;i<=n;i++) for(j=1;j<=i;j++) printf("*");  How many stars are printed in total?
questions.solutionApproach: Triangular loop: Σ(i=1 to n) i = n(n+1)/2 = Θ(n²).

questions.question: What is the minimum number of comparisons needed to find both the maximum AND minimum of an unsorted array of 10 elements?
Using exponentiation by squaring, how many multiplications are needed (at most) to compute x^13?
questions.solutionApproach: 13 = 1101 in binary. Squarings: x^2, x^4, x^8 (3). Multiplies: x * x^4 * x^8 (2). Total 5.
questions.answer: 5 multiplications (O(log n)), far fewer than the naive 12.

questions.question: int f(int n) { if(n<=1) return n; return f(n-1)+f(n-1); }  What is the time complexity, and how would you make it polynomial?
questions.solutionApproach: T(n)=2T(n-1)+O(1) → Θ(2ⁿ), exponential (doubling recursion shape). Fix: memoize results (store f(k) in an array as computed) → reduces to O(n) since each unique subproblem is solved only once.
questions.answer: Θ(2ⁿ) as written; O(n) with memoization.
